mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte wasting (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which potentiates candesartan's hypotensive and hyperkalemic effects, increasing risk of acute kidney injury and severe hyperkalemia.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (potassium, magnesium), and blood pressure closely; consider temporary discontinuation of candesartan during amphotericin B therapy or use lipid formulations of amphotericin B to reduce nephrotoxicity.
